content.title: Welcome to the Cursed Ark!
content.text:
Welcome to The Cursed Ark Cluster!

The Cursed Ark is a PvPvE ASA server with a friendly and active community, rates balanced for a busy life, fair and enforced rules, Quality of Life mods to reduce the needless busywork, a ton of dino mods balanced to vanilla perfection, and weekly events to help you get involved with the community!

The server is also CROSSPLAY!
Meaning everyone on EVERY console can play with each other.

Wipe Info
Wipes occur at no scheduled time.
I alone reserve the right to decide wipe times. They will happen at my discretion, and I will not give any details on when the next one might be.

For those who are curious what PvPvE means.
It means that this server is a place for PvP and PvE. Both actions are encouraged.
There will be periods of war and periods of peace, as is with a server where no one is expected to behave in any certain way.
In many ways, this is somewhat of an anarchy server in that regard.

Make sure you register your tribe with Tribe Registration.
Your tribe must be registered to receive services from admins. All you need to do is make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord and give your tribe name and a list of your members. Any changes in members must be notified in a follow-up ticket as well.

content.title: Server Rules (IMPORTANT)
content.text:
IMPORTANT!
These are the rules for the server.
Read them; not knowing them is not an excuse.

Social Rules

Follow the rules of The Cursed Realm or be Banished!

1. Don't be racist/sexist/homophobic/etc....
Jokes are acceptable, though judgments will be on a case-by-case basis. But I'm glad to say I've never had to ban someone for this stuff.

2. Do not post NSFW/NSFL ANYWHERE!
I have a no-tolerance policy on this.
I understand sometimes you may post a video that treads a thin line, so just be careful.

3. Do not dox another user.
Doxing is the act of exposing real-life information about someone. Not everyone is okay with their IRL information being online, so don't post it.

4. Do not spam ANY of the channels.
Repeating something a couple of times is good and funny, but there is a limit, and you'll know it when you do it, so this shouldn't be an issue.

5. If you are a bot, you WILL be banned. Or if you try to advertise something.
This is not an issue if you're a real person.

6. Do not @ everyone for any reason. Only IndyJacksonTT is allowed to do that.

Building Rules

These rules apply to how you are allowed to build things on the server.

1. No blocking off Obelisks, player spawns, boss caves (Tek cave, Lava Golem, Iceworn, Labyrinth, etc.), area entrances.
Violations will be met with destruction of the offending structures and more, depending on severity.

2. No excessive base spam. You can spam 15 foundations out from your base. What counts as your base is anything that isn't spam.
Violations will be met with destruction of the spam.

3. No Meshing. Meshing counts as any entrance below/inside the mesh.
Violations will be met with an instant tribe wipe.

4. No building in base spots that require strange methods to enter, like beds, chairs, grapples, jetpack, or knockout. If you have questions about a spot, make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord.
Violations will be met with destruction of the offending structures up to a full tribe wipe.

5. No building tunnels into enemy bases. This includes putting tunnels on platforms.
Violations will be met with removal of any raid spoils and further action depending on severity.

6. Platform creatures and rafts can ONLY have one side be fully covered. If the structure covers an entire side of the creature from view, the structure cannot be more than 1 wall wider than the creature itself. Your platform entity must be damageable. Essentially, don't take all the fun out of raiding by essentially protecting yourself from all turret fire.
Violations will be met with removal of any raid spoils and further action depending on severity.

PvP Rules and General Rules
These rules apply to how you are permitted to engage in PvP and general player interactions.

1. No Duping of items, dinos, or anything.
Violations will be met with a FULL tribe wipe.

2. No "Human" or "123" names. Your account AND player name must be unique. If you need help changing your name, make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord. Violations will result in me giving you a funny name.

3. Tribe Name and Tribe Members must be the same across ALL maps. Essentially, do not get around the 6-man tribe limit or try to disguise yourself as another tribe.
Violations will result in me removing tribe members from your tribe and changing your tribe name. If done maliciously, it will result in a tribe wipe.

4. A FOB must be picked up from an enemy base once the raid is complete or abandoned.
Violations will result in me destroying the FOB and any loot inside.

5. No using the Discord Tribe Log System to pretend to be another tribe and spy on their logs.
Violations will result in a tribe wipe.

6. No Admin Abuse. Admins are not allowed to use their powers to give themselves an advantage over other players. The Admin Logs Channel in the Discord helps keep us honest. If you have ANY suspicions, make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord.
Violations will result in removal of admin status and full tribe wipe.

7. No Destroying/Killing things in the "Admin" tribe unless told to by an event or admin. Violations could go up to a full tribe wipe depending on severity.

8. DO NOT revive the souls of event dinos. This includes ALL dinos present in events unless explicitly told you can.
Violations will result in the dino and ALL of its children being killed. And may go up to a full tribe wipe depending on severity.

9. DO NOT clone supermutant dinos that you win from events.
Violations will result in the cloned dino and the original being killed. And may go up to a full tribe wipe depending on severity.

10. DO NOT use any dino saddle with cannon raiding-like properties to destroy structures during a raid. This is defined as dinos with saddles that can damage turrets without needing to be in the turret's range, or whose projectiles are ignored by turrets. This includes but is not limited to: Sulfur Titan, Vectispinus, Barsboldia, and Livyatan. Traditional cannon raiding is permitted.
Violations could result in a full tribe wipe.

11. DO NOT PvP at the community center or any areas connected to it.

12. DO NOT use/create Desolatitan Bone Saddle BPs.

If you think I missed anything or wasn't concise enough, feel free to tag IndyJacksonTT in the Discord or DM him.

content.title: Shop Information
content.text:
We have a comprehensive shop on The Cursed Ark.
Powered by "MAGA Ark’s Shop Mod" and the Admin.

You can see the shop by pressing F1 or opening it in the Radial Wheel.

The shop has basically Everything: dinos, resources, kits, and boss packs. The only thing the shop DOES NOT have is equipment, so no saddles, weapons, or blueprints; though some equipment is available in kits.

You can buy stuff in the shop using the points you get by just being logged into the server. You get 1 point every 36 seconds, or 100 points an hour.

Here's the important part, though.
There is a 2nd shop. The admin shop, which is run manually by the Admin.
To use this shop, your tribe must be registered. Check out how to register inCursed Ark Info.

All the prices and products in the admin shop are the same except that the currency is "BerryBush Seeds", which you can find in all supply drops, cave drops, alpha drops, OSDs, and boss drops.

You can also obtain BBS (BerryBush Seeds) by donating to the server through our Tebex store. Check out the donation tab for more info.

I really don’t like P2W, but there needs to be some incentive to donate. So I try to keep it balanced and fair by not locking anything behind a paywall, only allowing donations to give a sizeable advantage. This is an unfortunate necessity if we want to keep the server running.

You can also obtain BBS by helping to advertise the server.
Just post a pic of your contribution in the Submissions Channel on the Discord and make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord.
You can advertise the server once a day and will receive 500 BBS every time you do.

The OTHER important part.
Any dinos purchased through the admin shop are 50% off! This ONLY applies to dinos.

In addition,
BBS can be used to purchase a "Best of 5" version of any dino for 3x the normal BBS, or 1.5x the normal shop price, so a "Best of 5" Tyrannosaurus would be 3750 BBS.

Essentially, you get 5 "rolls" on the dino you buy, and you get to keep the one with the best stats!
To make a “Best of 5” purchase, just say so in your purchase ticket.

Refund Policy
1. The purchased tame must not have left its cryochamber/cryopod.
2. The purchased tame must not have been leveled.
3. Refunds for in-game shop purchases will be given at half in the form of BBS.

Go to Cursed Ark Info for a list of shop prices!

content.title: Custom Base Spots
content.text:
We have a large number of custom base spots.
They vary from caves to high-up places.
They come in PvE and PvP varieties.

Custom base spots for maps that may not currently be running are still listed here. If a base spot here catches your eye but the map isn’t on the cluster, consider donating to add it.

The Center

Scorched Earth Reborn

Extinction

The Spiral Tower
28 lat, 6 lon | Ragnarok
One of the biggest custom base spots on the server, featuring 9 huge, flat floors with a single underwater entrance. 6x Damage on all floor entrances and main entrance.
This is an EVENT ONLY base spot. Meaning it is only available to winner of an event for it.

Aberration Portal Cave
41 lat, 10 lon | Aberration
A large cave spot near portal on Aberration. Bring ladders, there are no stairs. 4x Damage on entrance.

Hidden Sanctuary
41.5 lat, 40.9 lon | Aberration
A high-up fortress built into the ceiling of Aberration. Contains hidden rooms, corners, and choke points. 4x Damage on entrances and choke points.

Ragnarok Forest Cave
26.2 lat, 27.2 lon | Ragnarok
A modified version of a vanilla cave. Has 1 entrance instead of 3, and that entrance is made smaller.

Viking Bay Glacier Ice Cave
30 lat, 34.8 lon | Ragnarok
An exposed mesh spot turned into a functioning cave. It has a moderately sized entrance and a sizable interior.

Desert Cliff Overhang
49.3 lat, 72.7 lon | Ragnarok
A large overhang overlooking the desert of Ragnarok. This is a PvE-oriented spot.

Cove Cave Island
80.5 lat, 33 lon | Ragnarok
A large island with a sizable cave on it. 4x damage at the entrance.

The Maze Spire
70 lat, 92.6 lon | Ragnarok
One of the biggest custom base spots on the server. Featuring 6 massive flat floors, perfect for breeding and defense. Features only 2 entrances, one on top and one on the bottom, with 4x damage on each and 4x damage on the holes in the floors.

Gargantuan Glacier Cave
27.1 lat, 4 lon | The Island
A massive glacier with two large floors. 2x damage on both entrances.

Underwater Oil Cave
83 lat, 22.3 lon | The Island
A sizable underwater cave with a single entrance. It boasts a few oil veins for pumps. 2x damage on entrance.

Terminal Island
96 lat, 35.5 lon | The Island
A medium sized island with some natural formations. Boasts a city terminal for easy transferring. Features a small pond as well.

content.title: Mailbox Info (IMPORTANT)
content.text:
A mailbox is very useful on this server.

A mailbox is a storage box located at the Community Center; it serves as exactly its name implies: a mailbox.

A mailbox between your tribe and the Admins. The mailbox will have a 4-digit PIN code of your choosing. And whenever you want to make a purchase using the admin shop, get compensation for a bug, or get a giveaway/event prize, it will all happen in your mailbox.

This system lets the admins help you without both parties needing to be on at the same time.

IMPORTANT
The Community Center is located on Astraeos in one of the bays of Korinthos; it is on a large artificial mountain, and it is hard to miss. All Obelisks on Astraeos have a teleporter on them that can go to the Community Center.

ALSO IMPORTANT
Make a ticket in the Tickets Channel on the Discord to have a mailbox made. Just make sure your tribe is registered, and it won’t take much time at all. Check Cursed Ark Info for information on tribe registration.

When you want to use your mailbox, make another ticket and leave your BBS in your mailbox.

You ARE permitted to use your mailbox as a secure storage option, since breaking another player's mailbox is illegal.

content.title: Events and Giveaways
content.text:
Here at The Cursed Ark we run all kinds of events and giveaways!
Events usually include, raid bosses, raid bases, treasure hunts, races, arena fights, tournaments, and many others. I drop events around once a week but oftentimes I do many events in a single week. Sometimes I also go many weeks without doing an event, it is rather dependent on my personal life. Event schedules are not a promise though, so if I end up delaying an event it is because I am not able to run it at that time.

Giveaways usually include dinos, blueprints, saddles, resources, and other exotic rewards.
I do giveaways very frequently, usually only a couple days between each one.
Stay tuned to events in the Events Channel in the Discord.
Stay tuned to giveaways in the Giveaways Channel in the Discord.

content.title: Offline Raid Protection
content.text:
The Cursed Ark has Offline Raid Protection.
Powered by "Hyper's Offline Raid Protection"

Offline Raid Protection (ORP) is a structure that when placed down will make a radius around it that is under ORP. The structure is craftable at an early level and is rather cheap.

Effects of ORP:
Infinite Turret Ammo
999999x more structure resistance
ORP has a range of 100 foundations wherever it is placed.
ORP will activate 30 minutes after all players have logged off of a map, assuming no enemy is within range of your base.
ORP will decay after 2 days of no players logging in.
You can place as many ORP structures as you want!

content.title: New Player Protection
content.text:
The Cursed Ark has NPP (New Player Protection)!
Powered by "White Flag".

White Flag (New Player Protection or NPP) is an invincible forcefield that lasts for 7 days once placed. White flag will NOT protect you from PvP outside the forcefield though.

Rules to apply for NPP:
All members of your tribe must be younger than 7 days. No members of your tribe can have ANY bosses completed.

You may also receive a White Flag if you have real life circumstances that will prevent you from being on a for while, such as a vacation, a sickness, etc.

Apply for NPP in a ticket which can be opened in the Tickets Channel of the Discord.

Rules to follow when you have NPP.
You CANNOT start any PvP at ALL while under NPP or you will lose it. If you are attacked out in the world you may defend yourself, but do not initiate.

You may participate in PvP events like raid bases, arena events, etc…

If you are the victim of NPP abuse make a ticket in the Tickets Channel in the Discord.
Completing Bosses during this time will not remove your NPP.

content.title: Tribe Log System
content.text:
You can now have all your tribe logs cluster wide directed to your own discord!

This is a tutorial on how to do this.
Step 1: In your own discord, create the channel you want your tribe logs sent to.
Step 2: Click the gear icon on your channel and go to "Integrations".
Step 3: Under "Webhooks" click "create webhook" .
Step 4: A webhook with a random name will be made. Click on it, then click "Copy webhook URL". Hold onto this.
Optional Step: Change the webhook's name and profile picture if you wish.

For all these past steps you will need to be an admin in your Discord.
Step 6: Make sure your tribe name is the EXACT same across all maps as this is case sensitive. I would also go to each map to make sure no one else uses your tribe name. Step 7: Make a ticket in the Tickets Channel of the Discord and say that you want a tribe log relay set up. Then present the webhook URL and your EXACT tribe name.

Everything you need to do is done. The admin will take it from there.
PS: The admins will NOT be able to see your tribe logs as these logs will be sent to your own discord server. I wanted to mention this in case you're worried about privacy.

WARNING: If you change your tribe name the logs will STOP working and you will need to contact the admins to change it to your new name.
